# Physio exercises

## Notes

- Frank joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.
- Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast.
- Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 120 kilometres.

## Open questions

- Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner.
- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
- Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.

## Decisions

Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away. Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour.

## Context

- Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.
